 DREO Recalls DR-HSH015 Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards 
 U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission October 29, 2026 1 minute read 
 Last Updated on October 29, 2026 7:12 pm
 DREO is recalling about 338,800 space heaters sold in the United States because they can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards, according to the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission. About 36,300 more were sold in Canada. The recall was announced Oct. 29.
 Recalled DREO space heater, model DR-HSH015. (U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission) 
 The recall involves DREO space heaters, model number DR-HSH015. The ceramic, electric heaters are black, measure about 11.5 inches wide and 13 inches tall and include a remote control. Only units manufactured from April 2025 through January 2026 are included.
 DREO has received 17 reports of the space heaters igniting, three resulting in property damage and one in a burn injury to the hand.
 How to Tell if Your Heater Is Recalled
 The model number, “DR-HSH015,” and the manufacture date, in YYYY/MM format, are printed on a label on the heater’s underside. “DREO” appears on the front of the unit.
 The manufacture date, in YYYY/MM format, and model “DR-HSH015” are printed on a label on the underside of the recalled DREO space heaters. (U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission) 
 What to Do
 Consumers should stop using the recalled space heaters immediately and contact DREO for a free replacement space heater. Consumers will be asked to unplug the space heater, destroy it by cutting the electrical cord and follow instructions to send a photo of the destroyed heater.
 DREO can be reached toll-free at 833-820-0887 from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, by email at spaceheater@realtimeresults.net, or online at www.dreo.com by clicking “PRODUCT RECALLS” at the top of the page. More information is also available at www.recallrtr.com/spaceheater .
 Where They Were Sold
 The heaters were sold at Costco stores nationwide and online at Dreo.com, BestBuy.com, Kohls.com, Lowes.com, QVC.com, HomeDepot.com, B2BRenew.com and Costco.com from September 2025 through October 2026 for between $70 and $110.
 The importer is Hesung Innovation Corp, doing business as DREO, of Clifton, New Jersey. The heaters were manufactured in Vietnam. The recall number is 27-054.
